title: Petrarch's Poetry and Legacy (in English)
description: Considers the career of Francis Petrarch, his influential love poetry and letters, his literary friendships and his enduring obsession with Laura. Highlights the milieu of his work in fourteenth-century Europe. Emphasizes the lyrics of the Canzoniere but also includes Petrarch's correspondence, On Familiar Matters and Of Riper Years, reflections on his life and thought over four decades.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ENSH 347P, ENSH 340 (if taken in the same topic), ITAL 472, ITAL 472B, MEDI 320B.
